HGPP Certified Surface Protection & Antimicrobial Coating Solutions

Eon Coatings follows HGPP certification standards to deliver antimicrobial and surface protection coating solutions that meet strict performance, hygiene, and safety requirements. Our HGPP-aligned coatings are designed for environments where cleanliness, durability, and regulatory compliance are critical — including residential, commercial, healthcare, and institutional settings across Abu Dhabi and the UAE.

What Is HGPP Certification?

HGPP certification refers to a recognized compliance framework that evaluates the hygiene performance, safety, and effectiveness of antimicrobial surface coatings. It ensures that products have been rigorously tested to perform consistently under real-world conditions and meet defined quality benchmarks for coating integrity, microbial resistance, and surface protection.

Certified coatings are especially important for high-traffic and high-touch environments where contamination control and durable protection are essential.

  • Science-backed certification
  • Verified surface hygiene compliance
  • Valid for 12 months post-treatment

Eon Coatings’ Commitment to Quality

Eon Coatings is dedicated to delivering confident surface protection solutions that are

  • Compliant with recognized certification protocols
  • Aligned with local environmental conditions
  • Performance-driven
  • Tailored to client needs
  • Safe for daily use

Why Get Certified?

Certification builds confidence, credibility, and long-term value.

Brand Value

Showcase your hygiene commitment with the HGPP badge.

Credibility

Meet recognized safety and cleanliness standards.

Trust

Reassure staff and visitors with verified protection.

Sustainability

 Less detergent use, more sustainable living

What You’ll Receive

Certified materials to proudly showcase your hygiene commitment and credibility.

Frequently Asked Questions

Here are quick answers to what our clients ask most.

1. How long does the coating last?

Our Coatings typically last between 6 and 12 months, depending on usage and surface type. For high-traffic areas, we recommend routine inspections and touch-ups.

2. Is it safe for children and pets?

Yes, all our products are eco-friendly and non-toxic, making them completely safe for households, schools, and healthcare environments.

3. How soon can the space be used again?

Most areas can be safely used within 2-4 hours after application. For specific coatings, our technicians will advise exact drying or curing times.

4. Do you offer maintenance support?

Absolutely. We offer ongoing maintenance packages and post-service guidance to help prolong coating performance and surface hygiene.

Learn More

Ready to Protect Your Surfaces?

Let’s design a hygiene and protection program tailored to your space.

Schedule a Free Consultation

Advanced Surface Coatings & Cleaning Services Abu Dhabi

Eon Coatings provides advanced antimicrobial and surface protection solutions designed to improve hygiene, durability, and long-term performance of surfaces across residential, commercial, and industrial environments in Abu Dhabi and the UAE.

Smart Surface Protection

Antimicrobial Coatings

Protective solutions for cleaner, safer, and longer-lasting surfaces.

Our antimicrobial coating solutions help reduce the growth of bacteria, mold, and other microbes on treated surfaces, creating safer and cleaner environments.These coatings are ideal for high-touch and hygiene-sensitive areas where long-lasting protection is essential.

  • Anti-microbial Surface Coating

    Shields surfaces from germs and mold for a healthier environment.

  • AC Duct Mold-Resistant Coating

    Cleans and protects ducts for fresher, healthier air.

  • Stain-Resistant Furniture Coating

    Limits spills and stains on sofas, chairs, and upholstery.

  • Marble Protective Coatings

    Guard your marble against the toughest enemies—heat, acid, and stains—while keeping its natural beauty.

  • Deep cleaning of carpets & furniture

    Revives carpets and furniture – making them look and feel like new.

  • Mattress Cleaning and Sanitization

    Deep-clean and sanitize your mattress to eliminate dust, allergens, and bacteria for a healthier, fresher sleep.

  • Specialty Coatings

    Specialty coatings that protect exterior surfaces from weathering and deterioration.

Frequently Asked Questions

Here are quick answers to what our clients ask most.

1. How long does the coating last?

Our Coatings typically last between 6 and 12 months, depending on usage and surface type. For high-traffic areas, we recommend routine inspections and touch-ups.

2. Is it safe for children and pets?

Yes, all our products are eco-friendly and non-toxic, making them completely safe for households, schools, and healthcare environments.

3. How soon can the space be used again?

Most areas can be safely used within 2-4 hours after application. For specific coatings, our technicians will advise exact drying or curing times.

4. Do you offer maintenance support?

Absolutely. We offer ongoing maintenance packages and post-service guidance to help prolong coating performance and surface hygiene.
